# awscc_networksecuritymanager_rule (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkSecurityManager::Rule. Creates and manages a Network Security Manager rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_name` (String) The name of the rule.

### Optional

- `configuration` (String) The rule configuration as a JSON string.
- `firewall_type` (String) The type of firewall for this rule.
- `rule_description` (String) A description of the rule.
- `rule_type` (String) The type of rule.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `rule_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the rule.
- `rule_id` (String) The unique identifier of the rule.
- `status` (String) The status of the rule.
- `version` (String) The version number of the rule.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networksecuritymanager_rule.example
  identity = {
    rule_arn = "rule_arn"
  }
}
```
